identity_note: Matched Pando (pando.ai), the AI transportation-management-system (TMS) vendor with its main base in Chennai (PandoCorp Pvt Ltd) and US presence, which fits the batch website and freight sector. Not the HR-software Pando acquired by Lattice, nor other 'Pando' entities. Pando.ai was itself acquired by Fleetx.ai (announced 2026-08-20) and continues as a distinct brand.

profile.name: Pando (Pando.ai)
profile.description: AI-powered transportation management system covering freight procurement, dispatch/tracking and carrier freight audit & settlement, sold to enterprise shippers (manufacturers, retailers, distributors) such as Castrol, Godrej, Nivea, Marico, Sun Pharma and Honda.
profile.location: Chennai, India (main operations and all open roles; entity PandoCorp Pvt Ltd); US presence variously listed as California (2023 Series B release datelined San Jose) or Chicago
profile.year_founded: 2018 (Gartner, AmbitionBox, Inc42); The SaaS News says 2017
profile.founder: Nitin Jayakrishnan and Abhijeet Manohar (co-founders, per The SaaS News). Current CEO: Badrinath (Badri) Setlur, who continues to lead Pando.ai under Fleetx.ai.
profile.funding_detail: ~$45M total raised; $30M Series B (May 2023) co-led by Iron Pillar and Uncorrelated Ventures with Nexus Venture Partners, Chiratae Ventures and Next47. Acquired by Fleetx.ai (announced Aug 20, 2026; undisclosed terms).
profile.headcount: Sources disagree: Inc42 149 (down ~16% in 90 days); Bitscale 204; ContactOut 251; Gartner/Prospeo 201-500 band
profile.past_completed_deals: No acquisitions by Pando found. Pando was itself acquired by Fleetx.ai (announced 2026-08-20, undisclosed); combined entity targeting an IPO in 18-24 months.
profile.open_role: No corp-dev roles; hiring Enterprise Sales, Fullstack Developer, Visual Designer, Customer Success Manager (4 open roles, all Chennai) as of 2026-10-08

verdict.headline: Acquired by Fleetx.ai (Aug 2026) · not an acquirer · no corp-dev seat
verdict.detail: Now a brand inside Fleetx.ai; any M&A appetite sits with Fleetx CEO Vineet Sharma as the combined company prepares for an IPO.
